modalLead: The first time you open Config → Appearance, a themed popover points at Random theme — dismissible with Got it, Esc, or by changing the setting. Modern layout keeps many page tabs from widening the header. Help and the manual explain random picks and page-tab colour dots; the appearance sub-tab reads Theme; the favicon is refreshed.

items.text: Config setting promo for Random theme — on desktop, the first visit to Config → Appearance shows a one-time themed popover below the Random theme dropdown, with a pulsing highlight on the field. Dismiss with Got it, Esc, or by changing the setting. The Got it button stays put (no floating animation on the control). Progress syncs via discoverabilityState.seenSettingPromos in settings.json. Add future highlights by registering an entry in config-setting-promos.js and anchoring the field with data-config-setting-promo-anchor.

Appearance sub-tab labelled Theme — the panel that holds your saved theme, random picks, fonts, and background is now Theme (not General / Algemeen), beside Custom themes, so it matches what you actually configure there.

Help and MANUAL cover random theme and page-tab dots — Config → Help → Appearance and Workspace explain random theme modes and double-click tab colour dots; MANUAL.md matches. Config → Overview → Latest update summarises this patch from the same what's-new data as the ★ modal.

Modern layout header overflow — when you have many page tabs, the tab strip scrolls inside the header instead of widening the dashboard. The controls row clips horizontal overflow so the page no longer gains a sideways scrollbar.
Favicon updated — the root favicon.png is replaced with a smaller, cleaner asset.
